blocks.source: Canto IX
blocks.translation: Canto IX

blocks.source: Quel color che viltà di fuor mi pinse
blocks.translation: That hue which cowardice brought out on me,

blocks.source: veggendo il duca mio tornare in volta,
blocks.translation: Beholding my Conductor backward turn,

blocks.source: più tosto dentro il suo novo ristrinse.
blocks.translation: Sooner repressed within him his new colour.

blocks.source: Attento si fermò com’ uom ch’ascolta;
blocks.translation: He stopped attentive, like a man who listens,

blocks.source: ché l’occhio nol potea menare a lunga
blocks.translation: Because the eye could not conduct him far

blocks.source: per l’aere nero e per la nebbia folta.
blocks.translation: Through the black air, and through the heavy fog.

blocks.source: «Pur a noi converrà vincer la punga»,
blocks.translation: “Still it behoveth us to win the fight,”

blocks.source: cominciò el, «se non . . . Tal ne s’offerse.
blocks.translation: Began he; “Else. . .Such offered us herself. . .

blocks.source: Oh quanto tarda a me ch’altri qui giunga!».
blocks.translation: O how I long that some one here arrive!”

blocks.source: I’ vidi ben sì com’ ei ricoperse
blocks.translation: Well I perceived, as soon as the beginning

blocks.source: lo cominciar con l’altro che poi venne,
blocks.translation: He covered up with what came afterward,

blocks.source: che fur parole a le prime diverse;
blocks.translation: That they were words quite different from the first;

blocks.source: ma nondimen paura il suo dir dienne,
blocks.translation: But none the less his saying gave me fear,

blocks.source: perch’ io traeva la parola tronca
blocks.translation: Because I carried out the broken phrase,

blocks.source: forse a peggior sentenzia che non tenne.
blocks.translation: Perhaps to a worse meaning than he had.

blocks.source: «In questo fondo de la trista conca
blocks.translation: “Into this bottom of the doleful conch

blocks.source: discende mai alcun del primo grado,
blocks.translation: Doth any e’er descend from the first grade,

blocks.source: che sol per pena ha la speranza cionca?».
blocks.translation: Which for its pain has only hope cut off?”

blocks.source: Questa question fec’ io; e quei «Di rado
blocks.translation: This question put I; and he answered me:

blocks.source: incontra», mi rispuose, «che di noi
blocks.translation: “Seldom it comes to pass that one of us

blocks.source: faccia il cammino alcun per qual io vado.
blocks.translation: Maketh the journey upon which I go.

blocks.source: Ver è ch’altra fïata qua giù fui,
blocks.translation: True is it, once before I here below

blocks.source: congiurato da quella Eritón cruda
blocks.translation: Was conjured by that pitiless Erictho,

blocks.source: che richiamava l’ombre a’ corpi sui.
blocks.translation: Who summoned back the shades unto their bodies.

blocks.source: Di poco era di me la carne nuda,
blocks.translation: Naked of me short while the flesh had been,

blocks.source: ch’ella mi fece intrar dentr’ a quel muro,
blocks.translation: Before within that wall she made me enter,

blocks.source: per trarne un spirto del cerchio di Giuda.
blocks.translation: To bring a spirit from the circle of Judas;

blocks.source: Quell’ è ’l più basso loco e ’l più oscuro,
blocks.translation: That is the lowest region and the darkest,

blocks.source: e ’l più lontan dal ciel che tutto gira:
blocks.translation: And farthest from the heaven which circles all.

blocks.source: ben so ’l cammin; però ti fa sicuro.
blocks.translation: Well know I the way; therefore be reassured.

blocks.source: Questa palude che ’l gran puzzo spira
blocks.translation: This fen, which a prodigious stench exhales,

blocks.source: cigne dintorno la città dolente,
blocks.translation: Encompasses about the city dolent,

blocks.source: u’ non potemo intrare omai sanz’ ira».
blocks.translation: Where now we cannot enter without anger.”

blocks.source: E altro disse, ma non l’ho a mente;
blocks.translation: And more he said, but not in mind I have it;

blocks.source: però che l’occhio m’avea tutto tratto
blocks.translation: Because mine eye had altogether drawn me

blocks.source: ver’ l’alta torre a la cima rovente,
blocks.translation: Tow’rds the high tower with the red-flaming summit,

blocks.source: dove in un punto furon dritte ratto
blocks.translation: Where in a moment saw I swift uprisen

blocks.source: tre furïe infernal di sangue tinte,
blocks.translation: The three infernal Furies stained with blood,

blocks.source: che membra feminine avieno e atto,
blocks.translation: Who had the limbs of women and their mien,

blocks.source: e con idre verdissime eran cinte;
blocks.translation: And with the greenest hydras were begirt;

blocks.source: serpentelli e ceraste avien per crine,
blocks.translation: Small serpents and cerastes were their tresses,

blocks.source: onde le fiere tempie erano avvinte.
blocks.translation: Wherewith their horrid temples were entwined.

blocks.source: E quei, che ben conobbe le meschine
blocks.translation: And he who well the handmaids of the Queen

blocks.source: de la regina de l’etterno pianto,
blocks.translation: Of everlasting lamentation knew,

blocks.source: «Guarda», mi disse, «le feroci Erine.
blocks.translation: Said unto me: “Behold the fierce Erinnys.

blocks.source: Quest’ è Megera dal sinistro canto;
blocks.translation: This is Megaera, on the left-hand side;

blocks.source: quella che piange dal destro è Aletto;
blocks.translation: She who is weeping on the right, Alecto;

blocks.source: Tesifón è nel mezzo»; e tacque a tanto.
blocks.translation: Tisiphone is between;” and then was silent.

blocks.source: Con l’unghie si fendea ciascuna il petto;
blocks.translation: Each one her breast was rending with her nails;

blocks.source: battiensi a palme e gridavan sì alto,
blocks.translation: They beat them with their palms, and cried so loud,

blocks.source: ch’i’ mi strinsi al poeta per sospetto.
blocks.translation: That I for dread pressed close unto the Poet.

blocks.source: «Vegna Medusa: sì ’l farem di smalto»,
blocks.translation: “Medusa come, so we to stone will change him!”

blocks.source: dicevan tutte riguardando in giuso;
blocks.translation: All shouted looking down; “in evil hour

blocks.source: «mal non vengiammo in Tesëo l’assalto».
blocks.translation: Avenged we not on Theseus his assault!”

blocks.source: «Volgiti ’n dietro e tien lo viso chiuso;
blocks.translation: “Turn thyself round, and keep thine eyes close shut,

blocks.source: ché se ’l Gorgón si mostra e tu ’l vedessi,
blocks.translation: For if the Gorgon appear, and thou shouldst see it,

blocks.source: nulla sarebbe di tornar mai suso».
blocks.translation: No more returning upward would there be.”

blocks.source: Così disse ’l maestro; ed elli stessi
blocks.translation: Thus said the Master; and he turned me round

blocks.source: mi volse, e non si tenne a le mie mani,
blocks.translation: Himself, and trusted not unto my hands

blocks.source: che con le sue ancor non mi chiudessi.
blocks.translation: So far as not to blind me with his own.

blocks.source: O voi ch’avete li ’ntelletti sani,
blocks.translation: O ye who have undistempered intellects,

blocks.source: mirate la dottrina che s’asconde
blocks.translation: Observe the doctrine that conceals itself

blocks.source: sotto ’l velame de li versi strani.
blocks.translation: Beneath the veil of the mysterious verses!

blocks.source: E già venìa su per le torbide onde
blocks.translation: And now there came across the turbid waves

blocks.source: un fracasso d’un suon, pien di spavento,
blocks.translation: The clangour of a sound with terror fraught,

blocks.source: per cui tremavano amendue le sponde,
blocks.translation: Because of which both of the margins trembled;

blocks.source: non altrimenti fatto che d’un vento
blocks.translation: Not otherwise it was than of a wind

blocks.source: impetüoso per li avversi ardori,
blocks.translation: Impetuous on account of adverse heats,

blocks.source: che fier la selva e sanz’ alcun rattento
blocks.translation: That smites the forest, and, without restraint,

blocks.source: li rami schianta, abbatte e porta fori;
blocks.translation: The branches rends, beats down, and bears away;

blocks.source: dinanzi polveroso va superbo,
blocks.translation: Right onward, laden with dust, it goes superb,

blocks.source: e fa fuggir le fiere e li pastori.
blocks.translation: And puts to flight the wild beasts and the shepherds.

blocks.source: Li occhi mi sciolse e disse: «Or drizza il nerbo
blocks.translation: Mine eyes he loosed, and said: “Direct the nerve

blocks.source: del viso su per quella schiuma antica
blocks.translation: Of vision now along that ancient foam,

blocks.source: per indi ove quel fummo è più acerbo».
blocks.translation: There yonder where that smoke is most intense.”

blocks.source: Come le rane innanzi a la nimica
blocks.translation: Even as the frogs before the hostile serpent

blocks.source: biscia per l’acqua si dileguan tutte,
blocks.translation: Across the water scatter all abroad,

blocks.source: fin ch’a la terra ciascuna s’abbica,
blocks.translation: Until each one is huddled in the earth.

blocks.source: vid’ io più di mille anime distrutte
blocks.translation: More than a thousand ruined souls I saw,

blocks.source: fuggir così dinanzi ad un ch’al passo
blocks.translation: Thus fleeing from before one who on foot

blocks.source: passava Stige con le piante asciutte.
blocks.translation: Was passing o’er the Styx with soles unwet.

blocks.source: Dal volto rimovea quell’ aere grasso,
blocks.translation: From off his face he fanned that unctuous air,

blocks.source: menando la sinistra innanzi spesso;
blocks.translation: Waving his left hand oft in front of him,

blocks.source: e sol di quell’ angoscia parea lasso.
blocks.translation: And only with that anguish seemed he weary.

blocks.source: Ben m’accorsi ch’elli era da ciel messo,
blocks.translation: Well I perceived one sent from Heaven was he,

blocks.source: e volsimi al maestro; e quei fé segno
blocks.translation: And to the Master turned; and he made sign

blocks.source: ch’i’ stessi queto ed inchinassi ad esso.
blocks.translation: That I should quiet stand, and bow before him.

blocks.source: Ahi quanto mi parea pien di disdegno!
blocks.translation: Ah! how disdainful he appeared to me!

blocks.source: Venne a la porta e con una verghetta
blocks.translation: He reached the gate, and with a little rod

blocks.source: l’aperse, che non v’ebbe alcun ritegno.
blocks.translation: He opened it, for there was no resistance.

blocks.source: «O cacciati del ciel, gente dispetta»,
blocks.translation: “O banished out of Heaven, people despised!”

blocks.source: cominciò elli in su l’orribil soglia,
blocks.translation: Thus he began upon the horrid threshold;

blocks.source: «ond’ esta oltracotanza in voi s’alletta?
blocks.translation: “Whence is this arrogance within you couched?

blocks.source: Perché recalcitrate a quella voglia
blocks.translation: Wherefore recalcitrate against that will,

blocks.source: a cui non puote il fin mai esser mozzo,
blocks.translation: From which the end can never be cut off,

blocks.source: e che più volte v’ha cresciuta doglia?
blocks.translation: And which has many times increased your pain?

blocks.source: Che giova ne le fata dar di cozzo?
blocks.translation: What helpeth it to butt against the fates?

blocks.source: Cerbero vostro, se ben vi ricorda,
blocks.translation: Your Cerberus, if you remember well,

blocks.source: ne porta ancor pelato il mento e ’l gozzo».
blocks.translation: For that still bears his chin and gullet peeled.”

blocks.source: Poi si rivolse per la strada lorda,
blocks.translation: Then he returned along the miry road,

blocks.source: e non fé motto a noi, ma fé sembiante
blocks.translation: And spake no word to us, but had the look

blocks.source: d’omo cui altra cura stringa e morda
blocks.translation: Of one whom other care constrains and goads

blocks.source: che quella di colui che li è davante;
blocks.translation: Than that of him who in his presence is;

blocks.source: e noi movemmo i piedi inver’ la terra,
blocks.translation: And we our feet directed tow’rds the city,

blocks.source: sicuri appresso le parole sante.
blocks.translation: After those holy words all confident.

blocks.source: Dentro li ’ntrammo sanz’ alcuna guerra;
blocks.translation: Within we entered without any contest;

blocks.source: e io, ch’avea di riguardar disio
blocks.translation: And I, who inclination had to see

blocks.source: la condizion che tal fortezza serra,
blocks.translation: What the condition such a fortress holds,

blocks.source: com’ io fui dentro, l’occhio intorno invio:
blocks.translation: Soon as I was within, cast round mine eye,

blocks.source: e veggio ad ogne man grande campagna,
blocks.translation: And see on every hand an ample plain,

blocks.source: piena di duolo e di tormento rio.
blocks.translation: Full of distress and torment terrible.

blocks.source: Sì come ad Arli, ove Rodano stagna,
blocks.translation: Even as at Arles, where stagnant grows the Rhone,

blocks.source: sì com’ a Pola, presso del Carnaro
blocks.translation: Even as at Pola near to the Quarnaro,

blocks.source: ch’Italia chiude e suoi termini bagna,
blocks.translation: That shuts in Italy and bathes its borders,

blocks.source: fanno i sepulcri tutt’ il loco varo,
blocks.translation: The sepulchres make all the place uneven;

blocks.source: così facevan quivi d’ogne parte,
blocks.translation: So likewise did they there on every side,

blocks.source: salvo che ’l modo v’era più amaro;
blocks.translation: Saving that there the manner was more bitter;

blocks.source: ché tra li avelli fiamme erano sparte,
blocks.translation: For flames between the sepulchres were scattered,

blocks.source: per le quali eran sì del tutto accesi,
blocks.translation: By which they so intensely heated were,

blocks.source: che ferro più non chiede verun’ arte.
blocks.translation: That iron more so asks not any art.

blocks.source: Tutti li lor coperchi eran sospesi,
blocks.translation: All of their coverings uplifted were,

blocks.source: e fuor n’uscivan sì duri lamenti,
blocks.translation: And from them issued forth such dire laments,

blocks.source: che ben parean di miseri e d’offesi.
blocks.translation: Sooth seemed they of the wretched and tormented.

blocks.source: E io: «Maestro, quai son quelle genti
blocks.translation: And I: “My Master, what are all those people

blocks.source: che, seppellite dentro da quell’ arche,
blocks.translation: Who, having sepulture within those tombs,

blocks.source: si fan sentir coi sospiri dolenti?».
blocks.translation: Make themselves audible by doleful sighs?”

blocks.source: E quelli a me: «Qui son li eresïarche
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Here are the Heresiarchs,

blocks.source: con lor seguaci, d’ogne setta, e molto
blocks.translation: With their disciples of all sects, and much

blocks.source: più che non credi son le tombe carche.
blocks.translation: More than thou thinkest laden are the tombs.

blocks.source: Simile qui con simile è sepolto,
blocks.translation: Here like together with its like is buried;

blocks.source: e i monimenti son più e men caldi».
blocks.translation: And more and less the monuments are heated.”

blocks.source: E poi ch’a la man destra si fu vòlto,
blocks.translation: And when he to the right had turned, we passed

blocks.source: passammo tra i martìri e li alti spaldi.
blocks.translation: Between the torments and high parapets.
